scope: Three exact Original slot/ID tuples and existing mixed candidates; wrong slot/ID/version/extra data and malformed encodings rejected.

historicalFixture.name: regression.test.mjs host fixture

export.samplingLimitation: RSS watchdog is sampled, not a hard aggregate cap.

independentStaticReview.scope: Source hashes, two/four-file deltas, strict contracts and existing execution records. Not an independent browser run.

observations: Controls enable only after both comparison frames visibly reach Tasks.
Actual link includes three exact identifiers and null calendar; frame routes remain unchanged by candidate selection.
Native page preloads source-pinned text but keeps the default Handbook basket and product.
Explicit restore changes only the basket. Selection entry makes product inert without applying.
Explicit apply and return show assistant/manual/history actions, Original dark tabs with 46px minimum height, and Original 80px rows together.
One root, one tablist and exact new export main observed; product inert removed on return.
Owned tabs closed and local preview stopped with exit zero.
observationNotes: A role locator timed out because selection mode made product tabs inert; read-only DOM inspection confirmed state without repeating the action.
Immediate inventory briefly retained a closing comparison tab; final inventory confirmed both owned tabs gone.

oldHandoffExport.reason: Historical interrupted export had no recovered terminal/harvest. This successful export does not establish its historical outcome.

limits: Only three historical fragments are transported, not whole Original, full filter slot, calendar or global theme.
Comparison and native workbench retain distinct synthetic cases; only candidate identifiers are transferred.
No new narrow/native, broad keyboard/accessibility, whole product-owner/account/scope, persistence or four-variant regression matrix.
